theme.&nbsp;<strong>الفرشاة (دقيقتين):</strong: Toothbrush (2 minutes): Apply toothpaste, place the brush in your mouth, then switch it on. Move it at a 45-degree angle along the gumline without pressing. The smart timer alerts you every 30 seconds to move to the next quarter.
theme.&nbsp;<strong>منظف اللسان (10 ثواني):</s: Tongue cleaner (10 seconds): Stick out your tongue, place the cleaner at the back of it, and gently pull it forward 3 to 5 times. Rinse it with water between strokes.

theme.<p>إجابات سريعة عن الباقة والشحن والضمان: Quick answers about the bundle, shipping and warranty.
theme.هل ينفع نستخدم فرشاة واحدة ونغيّر الرأس: Can we share one toothbrush and just switch the head?
theme.<p>لأ. الفرشاة أداة شخصية ومينفعش تتشارك: No. A toothbrush is a personal item and shouldn't be shared for hygiene reasons, which is why the bundle includes two toothbrushes.
theme.منظف اللسان ضروري ولا الفرشاة كفاية؟: Do I really need a tongue cleaner, or is the toothbrush enough?
theme.<p>الفرشاة بتنظف السنان، لكن الطبقة اللي: The toothbrush cleans your teeth, but the layer on your tongue needs a dedicated tool. The tongue cleaner completes your routine in 10 seconds.
theme.منظف اللسان بيوجع أو بيسبب ترجيع؟: Does the tongue cleaner hurt or cause gagging?
theme.<p>لو استخدمته برفق ومدخلتوش لآخر الحلق: If you use it gently and don't push it too far back, it won't hurt. If you feel a gag reflex, start from the middle of your tongue and gradually move further back over time.
theme.الـ 16 رأس هيكفّونا قد إيه؟: How long will the 16 brush heads last us?
theme.<p>كل فرشاة جاية معاها 8 رؤوس، والرأس بي: Each toothbrush comes with 8 heads, and a head is replaced about every 3 months. That's around two years for each of you.
theme.ينفع نختار لونين مختلفين للفرشتين؟: Can we choose different colors for the two toothbrushes?
theme.<p>أيوه، تقدر تختار أي لونين للفرشتين من: Yes. You can choose any two of the four toothbrush colors (Pink, Blue, White, Black), plus the color of each tongue cleaner (Orange, Green, Blue, Black).
theme.هل الفرشاة مناسبة للأسنان الحساسة؟: Is the toothbrush suitable for sensitive teeth?
theme.<p>أيوه. فيه وضع Sensitive اهتزازه ألطف،: Yes. There's a Sensitive mode with gentler vibrations, and the bundle includes 4 heads designed for sensitive teeth.
theme.ينفع تتستخدم مع التقويم أو الحشو أو الزر: Can it be used with braces, fillings or implants?
theme.البطارية بتعيش قد إيه؟: How long does the battery last?
theme.<p>لحد 120 يوم بشحنة واحدة لو استخدمتها: Up to 120 days on a single charge when used twice a day. A full charge takes 2 to 3 hours via USB-C.
theme.<p>التوصيل لكل محافظات مصر بياخد من 2 لـ: Delivery to all governorates in Egypt takes 2 to 7 business days. Shipping is free on orders paid online; a 100 EGP shipping fee applies to other payment methods, such as cash on delivery.
theme.<p>أيوه، خلال 7 أيام من الاستلام، بشرط إ: Yes, within 7 days of delivery, provided the bundle is returned complete, in its original condition and unused. Returns for reasons unrelated to product quality are subject to a 100 EGP restocking and shipping fee.
theme.<p>ضمان سنة كاملة على الفرشتين ضد عيوب ا: A full one-year warranty on both toothbrushes against manufacturing defects.
theme.أقدر أشتري رؤوس بديلة بعدين؟: Can I buy replacement brush heads later?
theme.<p>أيوه، باك 4 رؤوس متاح على الموقع.</p>: Yes, a 4-head pack is available on our website.
theme.فريق SNOSHA في خدمتك: The SNOSHA team is here to help
theme.تواصل معنا لأي استفسار عن منتجاتنا أو طل: Contact us with any question about our products, your order or shipping — our team is ready to reply as quickly as possible.
theme.<p>الفرشاة بتنظف السنان، لكن اللسان كمان:
A toothbrush cleans your teeth, but a white layer of bacteria and food residue also builds up on your tongue, and a toothbrush alone doesn't remove it well. That's why we made this bundle: a sonic toothbrush for teeth and gums, and a tongue cleaner for the layer on your tongue. The result is a complete routine and fresh breath all day.
And because a toothbrush is personal and shouldn't be shared, each of you gets your own toothbrush, tongue cleaner and color, with the same quality.
